sections.description: Choose the {{appName}} set that best fits your institution or use case. Each set is specially structured for different needs. It builds language skills through structured play, engaging activities, and rich digital content.

items.title: Preschool Series
items.description: Designed for large classrooms, schools, and kindergartens. Content and games are structured for classroom management, suitable for large groups. Offers a model where the entire class can actively participate simultaneously.

items.title: Workshop
items.description: Designed for small groups of 3–5 people. Content and games are arranged for more intensive interaction and individual participation. Offers a more focused and fast-paced application structure.

items.title: Home Tutor / Home Series
items.description: Suitable for 1–2 person individual use. Content and games are fully adapted for one-on-one learning. Provides child-specific progress and maximum attention.
